name: Base44 MCP
description: Creates and edits Base44 apps from ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor: build projects from a prompt, edit code in the sandbox, query app data, and call the platform API.

skills.name: Create and Edit Projects
skills.description: Creates a Base44 project from a text description and hands follow-up changes to the app editor's AI, on any branch.

skills.name: Sandbox Code Editing
skills.description: Reads, searches, writes, and edits files and runs shell commands in an app's cloud sandbox, then saves checkpoints.

skills.name: Entity Data
skills.description: Defines entity schemas and queries, creates, and updates records in a Base44 project's entities.

skills.name: Platform API Calls
skills.description: Finds and calls Base44 platform API operations for deploys, analytics, secrets, custom domains, and workflows.

skills.name: Connector Setup
skills.description: Lists a project's third-party connectors, shows which are connected, and starts a connection for one that isn't.
